opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing a key question in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports members developing new educational resources or conducting educational research in physiology.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalise projects and promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports pilot studies, technique development, and knowledge exchange activities in physiology.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives or Fellows to host events such as internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach at their organisation.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers requiring additional support to achieve their full potential.
opportunities.summary: Provides support to postdoctoral researchers to overcome barriers and advance physiology research.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles.
